# Subway Seat for Kakoune

Copy the `.kak` files to `~/.config/kak/colors/`. Covers the builtin, code and markup faces, plus kakoune-lsp's diagnostics, inlay hints and references.

[Kakoune](https://kakoune.org) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/kakoune/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`colors/subway-seat.kak`](colors/subway-seat.kak) | ~/.config/kak/colors/subway-seat.kak |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`colors/subway-seat-tunnel.kak`](colors/subway-seat-tunnel.kak) | ~/.config/kak/colors/subway-seat-tunnel.kak |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`colors/subway-seat-enamel.kak`](colors/subway-seat-enamel.kak) | ~/.config/kak/colors/subway-seat-enamel.kak |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/kak/kakrc:

```conf
colorscheme subway-seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/kak/kakrc:

```conf
colorscheme subway-seat-tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/kak/kakrc:

```conf
colorscheme subway-seat-enamel
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
